sourceCopy.name: World Clock
sourceCopy.title: World Clock Online Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: See live local times in cities around the world, compare UTC offsets and daylight saving changes. Free, no account.
sourceCopy.intro: Keep several city clocks in view at once. Times update from your device clock and the browser’s time-zone database, including daylight saving changes where supported.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I compare times around the world?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Your local time, New York, London and Tokyo appear by default. Add or remove cities, then choose a 12-hour or 24-hour display. Each clock follows its city’s time-zone rules in your browser.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Does the world clock use my location?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No location permission is requested. The page reads your browser’s configured time zone to show your local clock. Nothing is uploaded or saved by UsefulVerse.

fields.maxClocks: You can show up to 8 clocks, including your local time.
fields.accuracyNote: Times use your device clock and its time-zone database. Future daylight-saving rules or device settings may be outdated.

messages.alreadyShown: That city is already on the clock list.
messages.maxReached: The clock list is full. Remove a city before adding another.
messages.invalidZone: Choose a supported city or time zone.
messages.reset: The default city clocks were restored.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this clock account for daylight saving time?
additionalFaqs.answer: It uses the time-zone data available in your browser and device for the selected city. Rules can change, so confirm important future appointments with an authoritative local calendar.

additionalFaqs.question: Why can two cities have a 30- or 45-minute difference?
additionalFaqs.answer: Some time zones use offsets that are not whole hours. The clock shows the current UTC offset supplied by your browser’s time-zone data.

additionalFaqs.question: Is this a time-zone converter?
additionalFaqs.answer: It shows several current clocks at once. To convert a chosen date and time between two zones, use the separate time-zone converter.
